hypotheses.Q0_manual_attention_trace_is_exact: The manual squared-attention forward path matches native attention/final states to maximum absolute error at most 1e-5.
hypotheses.Q1_full_weight_jacobian_predicts_native_: The attention-inclusive unfitted Jacobian predicts one-sided scale-0.5 native coordinate effects with fidelity at least 0.99 on every corpus.
hypotheses.Q2_full_jacobian_closes_the_mlp_only_gap: It improves native coordinate fidelity over the MLP-only analytic chain by at least 0.01 on every corpus.
hypotheses.Q3_full_jacobian_predicts_sparse_grammar: It predicts selected-edge and restricted-coefficient changes with fidelity at least 0.99 on every corpus.
hypotheses.Q4_qk_response_is_material: The exact QK-path Shapley component has absolute target projection at least 0.01 on every corpus.
hypotheses.Q5_value_response_is_material: The exact value/OV-path Shapley component has absolute target projection at least 0.01 on every corpus.
hypotheses.Q6_qk_value_interaction_is_material: The QK-by-value interaction norm is at least 0.01 of the complete analytic response on every corpus.
hypotheses.Q7_qkov_profile_transfers_ood: Each OOD residual/QK/value target-projection profile differs from FineWeb by at most 0.05 per component.
